paracetamol.purpose: Relief of mild to moderate pain (headache, toothache, muscle ache) and fever reduction.
paracetamol.dosage_warning: Standard adult dose is 500mg-650mg every 4-6 hours. NEVER exceed 4000mg (4g) within 24 hours. Overdose causes severe, potentially fatal hepatotoxicity (liver failure). Avoid combining with other paracetamol-containing combination cold medications.
paracetamol.food_instructions: Can be taken with or without food. Taking after food with a full glass of water reduces potential stomach discomfort.
interactions: Warfarin (increased bleeding risk with prolonged use)

amoxicillin.purpose: Treatment of bacterial infections including chest infections (bronchitis, pneumonia), ear infections (otitis media), throat/sinus infections, and urinary tract infections.
amoxicillin.dosage_warning: Commonly 250mg to 500mg every 8 hours, or 875mg every 12 hours. CRITICAL: Complete the full prescribed course even if symptoms resolve to avoid developing antibiotic resistance. Ineffective against viral infections (flu/common cold).
amoxicillin.food_instructions: Take at evenly spaced intervals throughout the day. May be taken with or immediately after meals to minimize gastrointestinal upset.

augmentin.purpose: Broad-spectrum antibacterial treatment for resistant bacterial infections of respiratory tract, ENT, skin, and urinary tract.
augmentin.dosage_warning: Typically 625mg (500mg/125mg) or 1000mg twice daily. Always complete entire course. High risk of antibiotic-associated diarrhea.
augmentin.food_instructions: MANDATORY: Take at the start of a meal to enhance absorption of clavulanate and significantly reduce gastrointestinal discomfort.
contraindications: History of penicillin-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction

azithromycin.purpose: Bacterial respiratory infections, community-acquired pneumonia, strep pharyngitis, sinusitis, chlamydia, and skin infections.
azithromycin.dosage_warning: Commonly 500mg once daily for 3 to 5 days (Z-pack). Do not take aluminum/magnesium-containing antacids at the same time. Monitor for cardiac QT prolongation in high-risk patients.
azithromycin.food_instructions: Tablets may be taken with or without food. If taking oral suspension, take 1 hour before or 2 hours after meals.
contraindications: History of cholestatic jaundice with macrolides

cetirizine.purpose: Relief of allergic rhinitis (sneezing, runny nose, itching), chronic urticaria (hives), and ocular allergy symptoms.
cetirizine.dosage_warning: Standard adult dose is 5mg to 10mg once daily. May cause drowsiness or psychomotor impairment in some individuals; avoid operating heavy machinery or driving until reaction is known. Avoid alcohol.
cetirizine.food_instructions: Take once daily, preferably in the evening / before bedtime. Can be taken with or without food with water.

montelukast.purpose: Maintenance therapy and prevention of chronic asthma, exercise-induced bronchospasm, and seasonal allergic rhinitis.
montelukast.dosage_warning: Standard dose is 10mg once daily. NOT a rescue inhaler; do not use for acute asthma attacks. Black-box warning: monitor for neuropsychiatric events (mood changes, vivid dreams, depression).
montelukast.food_instructions: Take in the evening with or without food. For exercise-induced asthma, take at least 2 hours prior to physical exercise.

pantoprazole.purpose: Treatment of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), erosive esophagitis, gastric/duodenal ulcers, and acid hypersecretion.
pantoprazole.dosage_warning: Standard adult dose is 40mg once daily. Long-term continuous use (>1 year) may increase risk of bone fractures, hypomagnesemia, and vitamin B12 deficiency. Do not crush or chew delayed-release tablets.
pantoprazole.food_instructions: CRITICAL TIMING: Take 30 to 60 minutes BEFORE the first meal of the day (morning breakfast) on an empty stomach with a full glass of water.

omeprazole.purpose: Heartburn, peptic ulcer disease, GERD, and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome; H. pylori eradication regimens.
omeprazole.dosage_warning: Standard dose is 20mg to 40mg daily. Swallow capsules whole; do not open, crush, or chew. Limit self-medication to 14-day courses unless under medical supervision.
omeprazole.food_instructions: Take 30-60 minutes before breakfast with plain water.
contraindications: Concomitant use with rilpivirine or nelfinavir

metformin.purpose: First-line oral management of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus; improves glycemic control by decreasing hepatic glucose production and increasing insulin sensitivity.
metformin.dosage_warning: Typically started at 500mg once or twice daily and titrated up to 2000mg/day max. Rare but serious risk: Lactic Acidosis, especially in renal/hepatic insufficiency. Discontinue temporarily prior to iodinated contrast radiologic procedures.
metformin.food_instructions: MANDATORY: Take with or immediately after meals to reduce gastrointestinal side effects (nausea, metallic taste, diarrhea). Extended-release (ER) forms should be swallowed whole with dinner.

glimepiride.purpose: Lowering blood glucose in patients with Type 2 Diabetes by stimulating insulin secretion from pancreatic beta cells.
glimepiride.dosage_warning: 1mg to 4mg once daily. High risk of HYPOGLYCEMIA (low blood sugar: dizziness, shakiness, sweating, confusion). Always carry fast-acting carbohydrates (candy/glucose tablets).
glimepiride.food_instructions: MANDATORY: Take with breakfast or the first main meal of the day. NEVER skip meals after taking this medicine.

amlodipine.purpose: Treatment of systemic hypertension (high blood pressure) and chronic stable angina / coronary artery disease.
amlodipine.dosage_warning: Standard dose is 2.5mg to 10mg once daily. Abrupt discontinuation may cause rebound hypertension. Inform doctor if peripheral edema (swelling in ankles or feet) occurs.
amlodipine.food_instructions: Take at the same time each day (morning or evening), with or without food. Avoid excessive grapefruit juice consumption.

telmisartan.purpose: Management of essential hypertension and cardiovascular risk reduction in patients unable to take ACE inhibitors.
telmisartan.dosage_warning: Standard dose is 20mg to 80mg once daily. Black-box warning: FETAL TOXICITY (strictly contraindicated in pregnancy). Monitor serum potassium and renal function periodically.
telmisartan.food_instructions: Take once daily at the same time with or without food. Maintain adequate hydration.

atorvastatin.purpose: Primary and secondary prevention of cardiovascular events; reduction of elevated total cholesterol, LDL-C, and triglycerides in hyperlipidemia.
atorvastatin.dosage_warning: 10mg to 80mg once daily. Immediately report unexplained muscle pain, tenderness, or weakness (rare risk of rhabdomyolysis). Periodic liver function monitoring recommended.
atorvastatin.food_instructions: Take once daily at any time of day (evening is traditional), with or without food. Avoid drinking large quantities of grapefruit juice (>1 liter/day).

ibuprofen.purpose: Relief of inflammatory pain, arthritis, dysmenorrhea (menstrual cramps), headache, and fever.
ibuprofen.dosage_warning: Standard adult dose is 200mg-400mg every 4-6 hours (max 1200mg OTC, or 2400mg under prescription). Prolonged use increases risk of gastrointestinal bleeding, peptic ulcers, and cardiovascular thrombotic events.
ibuprofen.food_instructions: MANDATORY: Always take with meals, milk, or immediately after eating to protect gastric mucosa and avoid stomach irritation.
contraindications: Active peptic ulcer disease or GI bleeding

aspirin.purpose: Secondary prevention of myocardial infarction (heart attack) and ischemic stroke (low-dose 75-150mg); acute pain/fever relief (high-dose 325-650mg).
aspirin.dosage_warning: Low-dose cardioprotection is typically 75mg-81mg daily. High risk of GI mucosal ulceration and bleeding. DO NOT give to children/teenagers with viral illness due to risk of Reye's syndrome.
aspirin.food_instructions: Take with or immediately after food and a full glass of water. Enteric-coated formulations (e.g. Ecosprin) must be swallowed whole without chewing.

salbutamol.purpose: Rapid relief and rescue treatment of acute bronchospasm in asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), and exercise-induced bronchospasm.
salbutamol.dosage_warning: Inhalation: 1-2 puffs (100mcg/puff) as needed for acute wheezing/shortness of breath. If requiring >2 times/week regularly, consult clinician for asthma step-up therapy. May cause temporary tremors and tachycardia.
salbutamol.food_instructions: Inhaler use is independent of food intake. Rinse mouth with water after use.
interactions: Non-selective beta-blockers (propranolol - may cause severe bronchospasm)

ondansetron.purpose: Prevention and management of severe nausea and vomiting induced by gastroenteritis, chemotherapy, radiation therapy, and surgery.
ondansetron.dosage_warning: Standard dose is 4mg to 8mg every 8 hours. Overuse or high IV doses may prolong the QT interval; use caution in patients with cardiac conduction abnormalities.
ondansetron.food_instructions: May be taken with or without food. Orally disintegrating tablets (ODT) should be placed on the tongue and allowed to dissolve without chewing.
contraindications: Concomitant use with apomorphine (causes profound hypotension)

levothyroxine.purpose: Treatment of primary, secondary, and tertiary hypothyroidism; pituitary TSH suppression in thyroid cancer management.
levothyroxine.dosage_warning: Dosage is individualized (25mcg to 200mcg daily) based on serum TSH tests. Overdosage leads to hyperthyroidism symptoms (palpitations, weight loss, heat intolerance, arrhythmia). Narrow therapeutic index drug.
levothyroxine.food_instructions: CRITICAL STRICT RULE: Must be taken FIRST THING in the morning on an EMPTY stomach with plain water, at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast, coffee, tea, calcium, iron, or other medications.
common_side_effects: Usually none at correct dose; symptoms of thyrotoxicosis if over-replaced

doxycycline.purpose: Treatment of respiratory tract infections, acne vulgaris, tick-borne diseases (Lyme disease, scrub typhus), malaria prophylaxis, and chlamydia.
doxycycline.dosage_warning: Typically 100mg once or twice daily. Must remain UPRIGHT for at least 30 minutes after taking to prevent severe pill-induced esophageal ulceration. Causes photosensitivity (sunburn risk). Avoid in children <8 years and pregnant women (teeth discoloration).
doxycycline.food_instructions: Take with a full glass of water (240ml). Can take with food if stomach upset occurs, but AVOID dairy products, milk, antacids, or iron supplements within 2 hours of ingestion (chelates and blocks absorption).
contraindications: Children under 8 years of age (tooth enamel hypoplasia)

clonazepam.category: Benzodiazepine Anticonvulsant & Anxiolytic (Schedule IV Controlled Substance)
clonazepam.purpose: Management of panic disorders, seizure disorders (myoclonus, Lennox-Gastaut), and acute severe anxiety.
clonazepam.dosage_warning: 0.25mg to 2mg daily. High risk of physical dependence, tolerance, and addiction. STRICT WARNING: Do not discontinue abruptly (severe rebound seizures/withdrawal). NEVER combine with alcohol or opioids (fatal respiratory depression).
clonazepam.food_instructions: Take with or without food with water. Evening or split dosing commonly recommended due to sedative effect.
